text: いかす　じてんしゃだな！

structure.jp: いかす　じてんしゃ

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いかす　じてんしゃ
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. いかす　じてんしゃ = 'a Bicycle that is cool'.

patterns.name: 〜な (exclaiming)
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a statement shows the speaker is impressed or thinking aloud. じてんしゃだな = 'that sure is a Bicycle'.
